protocol.scope: Fixed development solver check; not held-out controller evidence or an error enclosure.
protocol.checkpoint_rule: Compare both 2h and 4h endpoints; chain each arm from its own endpoint without resets.
protocol.physical_rule: Positive endpoint biomass, valid feed/volume and substrate minima sampled at accepted solver nodes; not continuous-path certification.

classification_rule.meaning: Synthetic target construction is declared before execution and tests numerical band discrimination only; it is not a scientific target-selection procedure.
classification_rule.near_boundary: Flag fixed targets within 2e-5 of the refined-reference band boundary; still report every label disagreement as a hard failure.

protocol.failure_rule: Do not loosen thresholds after failure. Record exceptions, missing checkpoints and all failed comparisons. Both original and refined independent arms must pass.
protocol.timing: Record every interval-call duration. Separate first engine call including possible JIT/cache loading; compare remaining matched calls descriptively. Exclude model construction and file I/O. No online controller speed inference.
